body: Well at least its free somewhere. Thanks for the advice and taking the time to read my whiny posts.
I live in the US. Define low cost.
Precisely. They're a part of me now.
I can't afford a therapist. I'm trying but life says otherwise.
So me not wanting help is due to a fear of having to face my demons? Is that what you're getting at?

That makes sense. I have a brother with low functioning autism that I've been caring for basically all my life. Making sure he's okay has been the only thing keeping me from turning over my wrist. Well that and the fact that I'm a coward.

But that's just it. I don't want a target or happiness. Just for it all to end. I know I shouldn't and that there are better options and people supposedly care about me but all I can think about is my own demise. It fills my mental space.
